title: COALESCE Expression
description: Learn how to use COALESCE to handle NULL values in queries.

data.text: The COALESCE expression accepts a number of arguments, evaluates them in sequence, and returns the first non-null argument.

data.title: Substitute NULL with a value
data.content: Replaces NULL phone numbers with N/A.
data.code:
SELECT
    first_name,
    last_name,
    COALESCE(phone, 'N/A') AS phone,
    email
FROM
    sales.customers

data.title: COALESCE for salary calculation
data.content: Uses the first non-NULL rate for salary calculation.
data.code:
SELECT
    staff_id,
    COALESCE(
        hourly_rate * 22 * 8,
        weekly_rate * 4,
        monthly_rate
    ) AS monthly_salary
FROM
    salaries;

data.text: COALESCE is syntactic sugar for a CASE expression. The query optimizer may rewrite COALESCE as CASE internally.

data.title: COALESCE Key Points
points: COALESCE returns the first non-null argument.
It can be used in any clause that accepts an expression.
COALESCE is equivalent to a CASE expression.
Useful for substituting NULL values with defaults.
